_comment: Terms a retirement removed from the system, read by .ci/scripts/quality/check_retired_terms.py
(check:ci-retired-terms). An OPEN worklist item or a LIVE plan that names one of them is
planning work on something that no longer exists, unless its text cites one of the entry's
retired_by references, which is the work doing the retiring.
FIELDS. id: the stable key the baseline and the output use. pattern: a Python regular
expression, searched (never anchored) over the subject's whole text. case_sensitive: false
compiles it with re.IGNORECASE, true compiles it as written. retired: the ISO date of the
retirement. reason: why the term is gone. retired_by: the plans (a path; a subject matches
it by the file's stem, so PLAN-x matches agent/plans/PLAN-x.md wherever the plan has moved)
and worklist items (#<hex id>) doing the retiring. must_match and must_not_match: texts the
pattern is run against on every run, both directions, so a pattern edited into vacuity or
into over-reach reds before it judges anything.
plan_baseline is SHRINK-ONLY debt: live plans that named a term on the day this gate
landed. A new (plan, term) pair is a refusal and is never added here; a baselined pair
that stops firing is a refusal too, drained with --write-baseline (which only ever removes).
Each entry carries a BLOCKER reason, checked by rediacc_ci.core.allowlist.validate_reason.

terms.reason: rclone is being removed completely, payload and feature: backups move to the S3/R2 chunk store and nothing may plan new rclone work (operator 2026-10-15).
must_match: bake rclone into the E2E VM image
must_not_match: a plain backup to the chunk store

terms.reason: the pre-rename account worker secrets BACKUP_S3_{ACCESS_KEY_ID,BUCKET,ENDPOINT,SECRET_ACCESS_KEY} are removed from the six regional workers; the live family is ACCOUNT_BACKUP_S3_*.
must_match: set BACKUP_S3_BUCKET on the eu worker

terms.reason: the Bitwarden secret R2_TOKEN_AUTH_API is deleted from the store and the map (7d2869ccb).
the bare R2 bucket edge-rediacc-configs is deleted; the regional buckets edge-rediacc-configs-<region> are live and are not this term.
the R2 bucket rediacc-backups-probe is deleted.
must_match: write a probe object to rediacc-backups-probe
